scope: Verify index removal and the immutable checked present or absent roles, including the optional selector and lifetime invariant.

common: Check::input($ifExists || $target instanceof IndexReference, 'An absent DROP INDEX target requires IF EXISTS.');
Check::input(!str_starts_with($name->key(), 'sqlite_'), 'An ordinary index cannot belong to the reserved SQLite namespace.');
Check::input($drop->object === SchemaObjectKind::Index, 'An index removal requires the DROP INDEX operation.');

Check::input($context->relationNames === $comparison && isset($path[1]) && $comparison->equal($path[0]->value, 'temp') && $comparison->equal($path[1]->value, 'main'), 'DROP INDEX requires SQLite comparison and schema search order.');
Check::input(count($matches) <= 1, 'Conflicting declared indexes share the selected coordinate.');
Check::input($index->removable, 'SQLite cannot drop a UNIQUE or PRIMARY KEY constraint index.');
$target = new IndexReference(new Identifier($index->schema->value), new Identifier($index->name->value), new Identifier($index->table->value));
Check::input($schema !== null || $context->complete, 'Unqualified DROP INDEX cannot skip an open schema.');
Check::input($context->complete && $drop->ifExists, 'DROP INDEX requires a resolved index or a known guarded absence.');
Check::input(!$reserved || $context->knowsConstraintIndexes($schema), 'A reserved index absence needs a complete implicit index namespace.');
return new DropIndex(new MissingIndex($name, $schema === null ? null : new Identifier($schema->value)), true);

change: Require the selected native constraint index to be removable and allow a reserved absence only with a complete implicit namespace.
